method: Re-ran the scope reconstruction, geography overlay, neighbor-tier screen, per-row/per-parent assessment generator, and controls twice with pinned Python 3.12.14, Shapely 2.1.2 and pyproj 3.7.2. Whole-file SHA-256 receipts were byte-identical across both runs.
limitations: Reproducibility establishes deterministic processing, not source truth or legal boundary accuracy.
